episodes.synopsis: Grid hopes to strike it rich in the VR game Satisfy. While taking on an S-Ranked quest, he discovers Pagma’s Tome.
episodes.title: Legendary Class

episodes.synopsis: Grid has made a fresh start. With nowhere else to turn, he begins learning the fundamentals of blacksmithing.
episodes.title: First Step Towards Being a Blacksmith

episodes.synopsis: The Mero Company sends Huroi, an Orator, to the village. There, he forcibly triggers a hidden quest...!?
episodes.title: Second Class

episodes.synopsis: Grid faces Euphemina in a blacksmithing contest. The contest turns into an S-Ranked quest to rescue Huroi.
episodes.title: Item Crafting Face-Off

episodes.synopsis: Grid continues his blacksmithing. He puts up an epic armor for auction, and gets a request for more.
episodes.title: Family's Trust

episodes.synopsis: Grid goes with Khan to visit his son's grave. He gets a new job quest: to learn "Pagma's Sword Dance."
episodes.title: First Boss Raid

episodes.synopsis: Grid heads to Kesan Canyon for his job quest. On the way, he meets his old bullies from the real world.
episodes.title: Pagma's Sword Dance

episodes.synopsis: Grid is asked to make the Divine Shield. He completes it, but the Yatan Church steals it.
episodes.title: Yatan's High Priest

episodes.synopsis: Grid fights in a raid against Malaxus. Malaxus is almost defeated when he turns the tide with powerful magic…
episodes.title: Comrades in the Guild
